physics-killer-03.title: Hojii fi jijjiirama anniisaa makaanikaalaa
physics-killer-03.goal: Analyze the underlying scientific principles and deduce the correct conclusion.
physics-killer-03.material: Wanti massii $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ qabu ol-ka'iinsa $4\,\mathrm{m}$ irraa fuulaa muraasaa miidhaa hin qabne irra dhaabbataa sululee, kutaa ulfaataa lafa sararaa (dheerinni isaa $5\,\mathrm{m}$, humni wal-qixxaa'insaa wanta irratti hojjetu hamma isaa $11\,\mathrm{N}$ dhaabbataa) darbee, mirga irratti fuulaa garagaraa miidhaa hin qabne ol-ba'a. $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ fi diddaan qilleensaa yoo dagatame, kutaa ulfaataa keessatti angaan ho'aa uumamu $Q$ fi ol-ka'iinsi olaanaa mirga fuulaa irratti ol-ba'u hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.prompt: Wanti massii $2\,\mathrm{kg}$ qabu ol-ka'iinsa $4\,\mathrm{m}$ irraa fuulaa muraasaa miidhaa hin qabne irra dhaabbataa sululee, kutaa ulfaataa lafa sararaa (dheerinni isaa $5\,\mathrm{m}$, humni wal-qixxaa'insaa wanta irratti hojjetu hamma isaa $11\,\mathrm{N}$ dhaabbataa) darbee, mirga irratti fuulaa garagaraa miidhaa hin qabne ol-ba'a. $g=10\,\mathrm{m/s^2}$ fi diddaan qilleensaa yoo dagatame, kutaa ulfaataa keessatti angaan ho'aa uumamu $Q$ fi ol-ka'iinsi olaanaa mirga fuulaa irratti ol-ba'u hordoffiidhaan sirriitti kan wal-qabsiise isa kami?
physics-killer-03.s.s1.explain: Angaa makaaniikii jalqabaa $E_0=mgh_0=2\cdot10\cdot4=80\,\mathrm{J}$. Kutaa ulfaataa keessatti $Q=fs=11\cdot5=55\,\mathrm{J}$ gara ho'aatti jijjiiramuuf angaan makaaniikii hafe $80-55=25\,\mathrm{J}$ dha. Fuulaan mirgaa miidhaa waan hin qabneef $25=mgh$ irraa $h=\dfrac{25}{2\cdot10}=1.25\,\mathrm{m}$. Miidhaa dagatanii hanga $4\,\mathrm{m}$ ol-ba'a yoo jedhan deebii dogoggoraa ②, angaa hafe $25\,\mathrm{J}$ ho'a yoo jedhan deebii dogoggoraa ③, $mgh$ bakka $\frac12mgh$ yoo fayyadaman $2.5\,\mathrm{m}$ (deebii dogoggoraa ④) ta'a.
physics-killer-03.s.s2.prompt: Which scenario demonstrates the correct real-world application of this principle?
physics-killer-03.s.s2.explain: The fundamental principles of this inquiry are widely implemented in modern technology.
